summary.text: Elizabeth R. Guzman is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 22nd District, which covers part of Prince William County, and has served since January 14, 2026, with an earlier tenure listed as 2018-2023.
Guzman sits on the House committees on Education, Transportation and General Laws.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth R. Guzman was born in Jesus Maria, Lima, Peru, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Guzman's education as Northern Virginia Community College (A.D., Office Administration and Management); Capella University (B.A., Public Safety); American University, Washington, DC (M.P.A.); University of Southern California, CA (M.S.W.).
The profile gives Guzman's occupation as social worker and public administrator.

Guzman's listed memberships and affiliations include Sacred Heart Catholic Church; Harvest Life Changers Church; American University Diversity and Inclusion (board member); Girl Scouts of America (former member); CASA CIS (child advocate); Reprorising Virginia (board member).
